interpretation: Structural installed-base growth is strong, but UK-native manufacturer/installer channels already solve much of the generic control problem. Seek model-specific gaps, not generic reseller transplant.
Germany proves the category, but UK major-retailer entry means the generic-kit gap is likely short-lived. Look at compatibility/monitoring/services after installed base forms.
Large platform-count delta is interesting but not equivalent merchant census; UK already has manufacturer DTC and strong trade retailers. Validate broader exact-SKU catalogue and buyer intent.
Rapid EV stock growth does not imply an accessory gap. UK exact-fitment specialists are already present; focus on newly growing models/cohorts whose merchant coverage lags.
